<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 12"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Furnace Form](/Feats.aspx?ID=4247) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Fire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=72" />
<trait label="Impulse" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=502" />
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Polymorph" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=127" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 29

</column>

---

Opening your kinetic gate, you allow flames to consume your form and leave you a living flame. You gain the benefits of the [_fiery body_](/Spells.aspx?ID=115) spell (except the ability to cast [_ignition_](/Spells.aspx?ID=236)) until the end of your next turn. You can Sustain the impulse up to 1 minute, and when you do, you can Fly up to half your fly Speed. Your fire [Elemental Blasts](/Actions.aspx?ID=2125) deal an additional die of damage.

---
**Level ()** This duration is 1 minute, you can't Sustain the impulse, and you can Dismiss the impulse.

**Level (16th)** This duration is 1 minute, you can't Sustain the impulse, and you can Dismiss the impulse.
name: Furnace Form
